scope: Original full main comparison: 18 configurations (two backbones x nine methods), each 3905 task-input pairs x20 output positions. Separate 500-input seed-1729 control excluded.

fields.method_id: One of nine frozen main method identifiers.
fields.input_uid: Stable task-input identity; join with corresponding task manifest.
fields.success: Boolean: any successful output among original20slots; identical to SR_K20.
fields.delta: Boolean: any same-candidate all-target threshold success among20slots; may concern a different candidate than representative_slot.
fields.n_valid_slots: Integer0..20; nonempty RDKit-valid output positions. Duplicates count at each position.
fields.representative_slot: Zero-based successful representative original slot (0..19), or null when unsuccessful.
fields.RI_01: Stabilized signed relative-improvement mean across target properties for the representative; null for failures.
fields.Sim: Saved comparison-round2 source/representative similarity; null for failures. Not a full-precision candidate-level similarity threshold.
fields.SAS: Saved comparison-round2 synthetic-accessibility score of representative; lower means less estimated synthetic difficulty; null for failures.
fields.SR_K1: Boolean any-success in first1saved output position.
fields.SR_K5: Boolean any-success in first5saved output positions.
fields.SR_K10: Boolean any-success in first10saved output positions.
fields.SR_K20: Boolean any-success in all20saved output positions.

input_manifests.identity_note: Uses original saved source identity, including shared molecules across tasks. Clustering is not regenerated or canonicalized here.
input_manifests.source_file_field: Historical source location, recorded only; not required to execute reproduction.

aggregation.success_percent: 100 * successful_inputs / all_task_inputs; macro is equal mean over ten task rates; IND/OOD each mean over five respective tasks.
aggregation.threshold_percent: 100 * sum(delta) / n_task_inputs; then equal ten-task mean.
aggregation.successful_descriptors: Within-task arithmetic mean over inputs where success=true, then equal mean of ten task means. Undefined if any task has no successful representative; current data have successful representatives in every group.
aggregation.representative_rule: Successful candidate maximizing sum of relative property gains; source value zero uses candidate property value; exact score tie selects later original slot. This compact archive does not rerun selection.
aggregation.property_direction: Decrease mutagenicity; increase all other targets. Directional success is strict; threshold success uses >= the stated positive improvement.

bootstrap.method: Original NumPy default_rng multinomial cluster resampling; same sampled source-cluster multiplicities shared across methods/tasks; rates recomputed with resampled task denominators; equal task means;2.5th/97.5th percentile intervals.
bootstrap.scope: Paired source-cluster resampling conditional on fixed saved generations; no seed variance or multiplicity adjustment

fields.proposals: Molecular proposals generated in the evaluated configuration.
fields.responses: Returned model response sequences, including reasoning/feedback/judging as applicable.
fields.tokens: Returned output tokens with the corresponding backbone tokenizer.

workload.remaining_configurations: 14 configurations retain previously audited totals from inputs/workload/baseline_table2_k20_workload.csv; no per-input reconstruction for these in this component.
workload.excluded: Prompt processing, property computation, unreturned beam work, model loading, discarded attempts, historical branches outside evaluated configuration.

not_reproduced: Property prediction or independent RDKit validity checks
